name: qBittorrent
description: qBittorrent-nox with the web UI: a self-hosted BitTorrent client you control from the browser.

connection.title: Sign in to qBittorrent
connection.description: qBittorrent web UI. The username is admin. qBittorrent prints a temporary password to the container log on each start until you set your own.

guide.intro: A BitTorrent client with a browser UI. Set a permanent password first: Tools > Options > WebUI > Authentication. Config and downloads live in persisted volumes.

outputs.label: Web UI
outputs.help: Opens the qBittorrent web UI. Username admin; the temporary password is in the service log.

features.title: Browser-controlled downloads
features.description: Add, manage, and monitor torrents from a web UI, no desktop client needed.

features.title: Persistent storage
features.description: Config and downloaded files stay on project-scoped volumes across deployments.
